description: This file is a shell script for testing 'replace refs' functionality in Git. It contains test cases for various Git replace commands, patching mechanisms, graft manipulations, and object replacement scenarios, including signed commits and merge commits.

methods.name: add_and_commit_file
methods.description: Adds and commits a file with a given message in Git.

methods.name: commit_buffer_contains_parents
methods.description: Checks that a commit buffer contains specified parent commits.

methods.name: commit_peeling_shows_parents
methods.description: Verifies that peels of commit objects show the correct parent commits.

methods.name: commit_has_parents
methods.description: Checks if a commit and its peelings have the expected parent commits.
